         \r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            +
         $ruleName = "CyberShield-Quarantine"\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        +
         $serverHost = ([System.Uri]$Global:ServerUrl).Host\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          +
         \r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            +
         if ($action -eq "quarantine") {\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             +
             New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "$ruleName-BlockAll" -Direction Outbound -Action Block -Profile Any -Enabled True -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             +
             $serverIPs = [System.Net.Dns]::GetHostAddresses($serverHost) | ForEach-Object { $_.IPAddressToString }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  +
             foreach ($ip in $serverIPs) {\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           +
                 New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "$ruleName-AllowServer-$ip" -Direction Outbound -Action Allow -RemoteAddress $ip -Protocol TCP -Profile Any -Enabled True -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 +
             }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       +
             New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "$ruleName-AllowDNS" -Direction Outbound -Action Allow -RemotePort 53 -Protocol UDP -Profile Any -Enabled True -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                +
             Write-Log "[QUARANTINE] Agent quarantined - only server communication allowed" "WARN"\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   +
             return @{ success = $true; action = "quarantined"; server_host = $serverHost; server_ips = $serverIPs; reason = $Payload.reason; quarantined_at = (Get-Date).ToString("o") }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            +
         } else {\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    +
             Get-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "$ruleName*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-NetFirewallRule -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      +
