             "collect_backup_status"      { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-CollectBackupStatus } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          +
             "collect_process_lineage"    { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-CollectProcessLineage } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        +
 \r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    +
             # === Remediation jobs (remediation.ps1) ===\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            +

             "disable_service"            { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-DisableService -Payload $Payload } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             +
             "restart_service"            { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-RestartService -Payload $Payload } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             +
             "disk_cleanup"               { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-DiskCleanup } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  +
             "network_diagnostics"        { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-NetworkDiagnostics -Payload $Payload } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         +
             "service_health_check"       { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-ServiceHealthCheck -Payload $Payload } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         +
             "fix_firewall"               { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-FixFirewall } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  +
             "high_cpu_check"             { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-HighCpuProcessCheck } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          +
             "sync_blocked_websites"      { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-SyncBlockedWebsites -Payload $Payload } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        +
             "quarantine_agent"           { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-QuarantineAgent -Payload $Payload } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            +
             "apply_security_patch"       { Invoke-JobWithTimeout -JobId $JobId -Timeout $Timeout -Handler { Invoke-ApplySecurityPatch -Payload $Payload } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         +
 \r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    +
             # === Lifecycle jobs (inline - minimal logic) ===\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       +
             "update_agent"               { @{ success = $true; message = "Update delegated to heartbeat force_update mechanism"; agent_version = $script:Config.Version } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         +
             "reinstall_agent"            { @{ success = $true; message = "Reinstall delegated to force_update mechanism" } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        +
             "collect_info"               { @{ hostname = $env:COMPUTERNAME; os_version = [System.Environment]::OSVersion.VersionString; architecture = $env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE; agent_version = $script:Config.Version } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      +
             "integration_test_v3"        { @{ pong = $true; agent_version = $script:Config.Version; timestamp = (Get-Date -Format "o"); hostname = $env:COMPUTERNAME } }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            +
 \r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    +
             default {\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               +
                 Write-Log "SECURITY: Rejected unknown job type '$JobType' for job $JobId" "WARN"\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    +
                 @{ success = $false; error = "Unknown job type: $JobType"; exit_code = -1 }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         +
             }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       +
         }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           +
 \r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    +
         Write-Log "Job $JobId ($JobType) completed" "INFO"\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          +
         return $result\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              +
     }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               +
     catch {\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         +
         Write-Log "Job $JobId failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR"\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              +
         return @{ success = $false; error = $_.Exception.Message; exit_code = -1 }\r                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  +
